title: Energy autonomy
text: The buoy shall operate for at least 90 days with average solar irradiance of 1.0 kWh/m2/day.
rationale: Worst-case winter irradiance at the harbour latitude.
complianceEvidence: HS-A1.BA1-VER-0006: minimum state of charge 31% over 90 days.

checks.text: The irradiance figure needs a cited source. It currently rests on the power system assumption.
